documents.finding: TCGdex documents an extension-less provider card-image base, permits quality and extension selection, identifies low as 245x337, and recommends webp for web display. Set symbols and logos use a distinguishable non-card URL shape and are outside this decision.
The documented CardBrief response supplies a nullable image field as an assets.tcgdex.net card-image base associated with the provider card ID and local ID.
The pinned TCGdex database uses the MIT licence and requires preservation of its copyright and permission notice. This is provider evidence, not a warranty of underlying Pokemon artwork rights.

requiredRuntimeControls: Accept only an exact provider-supplied image base from a TCGdex card record whose language, provider set ID, provider card ID, and local collector ID match the URL path.
Require HTTPS, the exact assets.tcgdex.net host, the default port, no credentials, no query, no fragment, and a card path rather than a logo or symbol path.
Construct and return only the provider-documented low.webp rendition; never expose high, png, jpg, an extension-less base, or a standalone original.
Display the provider attribution text TCGdex reference on the rendered reference image.
Use memory-only image caching and do not prefetch the reference into persistent disk cache.
Provide client and backend source kill switches plus an exact language:set:card denial key.
Return null and render a neutral named placeholder on any mismatch, missing control, denied key, provider failure, withdrawal, or substantiated rights complaint.
Do not route set marks, product artwork, listing photos, canonical writes, asset acquisition, or training through this decision.
